newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Sappi to buy further 22 pct SD Warren stake.
newsitem.headline: Sappi to buy further 22 pct SD Warren stake.

text.p: South African paper and pulp producer Sappi Ltd said on Tuesday it will buy a further 22 percent stake in U.S.-based paper firm SD Warren for $138 million.

The acquisition will raise Sappi's stake in SD Warren to 97 percent of common equity and it said it has agreed to try to obtain the remaining stock, held by minorities, within 120 days after the close of the purchase.
The stake will be bought from DLJ Merchant Banking Partners and its affiliates and UBS Capital Corp, it said at the release of its year results.
Sappi said the purchase price was equal to $17.25 a share and would be paid before May 27, 1997.

It has the option to pay in Sappi shares or, in whole or part, in cash. If the share route was selected, the parties would arrange a simultaeous vendor placement of the Sappi shares for cash, it said.
